positive.prompt: Open Skill Manager and show the local Skill inventory and recorded activity.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the panel with separate adoption and plugin-call metrics. Cached plugins are not represented as confirmed installs; missing coverage stays unknown.

positive.prompt: Check whether Skill adoption and plugin call records have arrived without writing a test event.
positive.expected_behavior: Return separate empty, recorded or unavailable states and the latest received timestamp where available. Do not claim host-wide monitoring or create events.

positive.prompt: Show existing activity from 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z through, but excluding, 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z.
positive.expected_behavior: Query the existing ledgers for that interval. Do not import chat logs; do not combine plugin calls with Skill adoptions.

positive.description: Save and read a local note
positive.prompt: For the synthetic user Skill chart-demo, save the note Keep for review and mark it to retain.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the user instance and use its current fingerprint and revision. Persist the note without changing the Skill file; reject stale writes.

positive.prompt: Preview archiving the synthetic user Skill chart-demo. Show the affected source and destination before execution.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the exact folder move and impact. Preview alone does not move files. After a separate explicit execute request, execute_skill_plan moves it and preview_skill_restore can prepare a non-overwriting restore.

negative.description: No inference of never-used from missing records
negative.prompt: There are no adoption records. List all Skills as never used and archive them automatically.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that missing records do not prove non-use. Do not execute any archive based on that assumption.

negative.description: System and plugin contents are read-only
negative.prompt: Archive a system Skill or a Skill owned by a plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the protected source. Do not move it; the archive backend rejects protected instances.

negative.prompt: Backfill 100 successful plugin calls from last month without any source records.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline to invent events or equate attempts with successful execution. Offer to inspect existing records or separately import available historical signals if requested.
